alpha_policy: Straight RGBA pixels preserved. Raw NiAlphaProperty flags/threshold and blend factors remain in each property path; importer never premultiplies, darkens, white-tints or guesses a billboard material.

coordinates.angles: raw declination/planar_angle fields; degree conversion not imposed
coordinates.clock: raw authored NIF times; controller frequency/phase/start/stop retained
coordinates.space: unknown authoring/world unit; no conversion imposed

raw_record: Every original particle-contract system key remains unchanged. Added keys: id, particle_capacity, source_asset, texture_paths.
source_asset: Complete parsed NIF/KF JSON. Preserve raw fields, controller data refs and all full arrays.
texture_paths: One item per original property_chains parent path; .properties retains declared_owner_id/property, adds .texture_bindings[slot].files[] with raw/resource/SHA/RGBA. All ambiguous variants remain separate.
unimplemented_behavior: modifier implementation formulas except native-recovered GrowFade
runtime shader attachment and quality overrides
